results.requirement: Create isolated test data in Org A and Org B via real HTTP requests
results.expected: 201 for both projects and both tasks; each task belongs to its org
results.actual: 201 for both orgs; task A id=d99b49c7-c579-433b-8177-fcd850a6a80d key=ISA133KMWAORG_A-1, task B id=da1350b7-145b-4a3e-8184-e8db198108be key=ISB133KMWAORG_B-1
results.details: Org A=7ef45cdc-4562-4705-82eb-e3e0e940a5c0, Org B=7bb3deaa-5508-4030-8259-58b89f5377e7; projects ISA133KMWAORG_A / ISB133KMWAORG_B

results.requirement: Org B cannot retrieve Org A task
results.expected: 404 Not Found; no Org A task data in body
results.details: Cross-tenant GET returned no task data.

results.requirement: Org B cannot update Org A task
results.expected: 404 Not Found; Org A task remains unchanged
results.actual: PATCH 404 "Task not found"; Org A GET still 200 with title "Tenant A private task"
results.details: No cross-tenant mutation occurred.

results.requirement: Org B cannot delete Org A task
results.expected: 404 Not Found; task still exists for Org A
results.actual: DELETE 404 "Task not found"; Org A GET still 200
results.details: Task survived cross-tenant delete attempt.

results.requirement: Org B cannot list tasks of Org A project (tenant isolation on list endpoint)
results.expected: 404 Project not found
results.details: No cross-tenant list data returned.

results.requirement: Org B cannot create a task in Org A project (tenant isolation on create endpoint)
results.expected: 404 Project not found; no task created
results.details: No task created in Org A project.

results.requirement: Org A can still read its own task after cross-tenant attempts
results.expected: 200 with intact task body
results.details: Control check after TI-01..TI-05.

results.requirement: Prepare active project with tasks before archiving
results.expected: 201 for project and two tasks
results.details: Setup for AR-02..AR-08.

results.requirement: Archive the project
results.expected: 200 with status ARCHIVED
results.details: Project archived via HTTP.

results.requirement: Creating a task in an archived project returns 409
results.expected: 409 Conflict with explainatory message
results.actual: 409 "Cannot create tasks in an archived project"
results.details: Create blocked by archived project rule.

results.requirement: Modifying a task in an archived project returns 409
results.expected: 409 Conflict with explainatory message
results.actual: 409 "Cannot modify tasks in an archived project"
results.details: Update blocked by archived project rule.

results.requirement: Reading a task in an archived project still works
results.expected: 200 with original task body
results.details: Read remains allowed for archived projects.

results.requirement: Listing tasks in an archived project still works
results.expected: 200 with both tasks
results.details: List remains allowed for archived projects.

results.requirement: Deleting a task in an archived project follows implemented business rule
results.expected: Implemented rule: 409 Conflict "Cannot delete tasks in an archived project"
results.actual: 409 "Cannot delete tasks in an archived project"
results.details: Reported separately as requested: delete is blocked in archived projects; task is retained.

results.requirement: Task retained after blocked delete in archived project
results.expected: 200, task still present
results.details: No deletion occurred.

results.requirement: Prepare project with multiple tasks for cascade test
results.expected: 201 for project and three tasks
results.actual: 201 project CSC133KMWACASC; tasks CSC133KMWACASC-1, CSC133KMWACASC-2, CSC133KMWACASC-3
results.details: Setup for PD-02..PD-05.

results.requirement: Delete the project
results.expected: 204 No Content
results.details: Project deleted via HTTP.

results.requirement: Deleting a project also deletes its associated tasks
results.expected: 404 Task not found for each of the three former task IDs
results.actual: 404 Task not found; 404 Task not found; 404 Task not found
results.details: All three tasks were removed by the project delete cascade.

results.requirement: Listing tasks of the deleted project fails
results.expected: 404 Project not found
results.details: Project no longer resolves for task listing.

results.requirement: Repeating project deletion returns 404
results.expected: 404 Not Found
results.details: Idempotent delete is not implemented; repeat is correctly not found.

results.requirement: Task creation works with correct status, body and defaults
results.expected: 201; full task body; key=projectKey-number; defaults status=TODO, priority=MEDIUM, null optionals; no internal fields
results.details: Title trimmed; defaults/null optionals verified in other checks.

results.requirement: Creation response includes a valid Location header pointing to the new task
results.expected: Location header present; resolving it with GET returns 200 and the same task id
results.actual: 201 created, but Location header is missing. Response headers: {"connection":"keep-alive","content-length":"340","content-type":"application/json; charset=utf-8","date":"Wed, 25 Nov 2026 04:31:33 GMT","etag":"W/\"154-D223opiEyq9omX7QAUZzcWUrqKM\"","keep-alive":"timeout=5","x-powered-by":"Express"}
results.details: No URL was supplied, so there is no Location value to validate. src/tasks/tasks.controller.ts createTask() returns the service value directly with no @Header/@Res/Location handling.

results.requirement: Task retrieval works
results.expected: 200 with the created task body and no internal fields
results.details: Body matches creation response.

results.requirement: Task listing works
results.expected: 200 array of task bodies sorted by descending number; no internal fields
results.details: Descending number order matches repository implementation.

results.requirement: Task listing filters work
results.expected: 200 with only matching tasks for each filter
results.details: All three implemented filters returned only matching tasks.

results.requirement: Task updating works and omitted fields are preserved
results.expected: 200 with updated title/description; status, priority, assigneeId, dueDate unchanged; persisted value matches response
results.actual: 200 title="Updated endpoint task" description=null; GET confirms persistence
results.details: Partial PATCH preserved all omitted fields.

results.requirement: Task deletion works
results.expected: 204 No Content with empty body
results.details: Deleted task id=9ed97da7-fea1-496b-a4cf-cd96f094c5d4.

results.requirement: Deleted task cannot be retrieved and disappears from listing
results.expected: 404 for GET task; task absent from list
results.actual: GET 404 "Task not found"; list excludes id
results.details: Deletion is durable in the in-memory store.

results.requirement: Correct HTTP methods and URLs are enforced
results.expected: 404 for all unimplemented method/path combinations
results.details: Only the five defined routes respond.

results.requirement: Create validation: body shape and title rules
results.expected: 400 Bad Request for array body, missing title, blank title and title longer than 200 chars
results.actual: array body: 400 "Request body must be an object"; missing title: 400 "Title must be a string between 1 and 200 characters"; blank title: 400 "Title must be a string between 1 and 200 characters"; whitespace title: 400 "Title must be a string between 1 and 200 characters"; 201-char title: 400 "Title must be a string between 1 and 200 characters"
results.details: Manual service validation rejected all five invalid bodies.

results.requirement: Create validation: field types, unknown/read-only fields and enum
results.expected: 400 Bad Request for each invalid field
results.actual: invalid priority: 400, numeric dueDate: 400, numeric description: 400, numeric assigneeId: 400, read-only status: 400, unknown field: 400
results.details: All invalid create fields were rejected with 400.

results.requirement: PATCH validation rules
results.expected: 400 for empty body, unknown/read-only fields, invalid enum values and wrong types
results.actual: empty body: 400, unknown field: 400, read-only number: 400, invalid status: 400, invalid priority: 400, empty title: 400, numeric title: 400, numeric dueDate: 400
results.details: All eight invalid PATCH bodies were rejected.

results.requirement: Path parameter and X-Org-Id header validation on task endpoints
results.expected: 400 for non-UUID ids, missing header and non-v4 UUID header
results.actual: GET 400, GET 400, DELETE 400, GET 400, GET 400, PATCH 400, GET 400, POST 400
results.details: Header rule accepts only v4 UUIDs (regex in src/common/decorators/org-id.decorator.ts); v1 org 11111111-1111-1111-8111-111111111111 was rejected.

results.requirement: List filter enum validation
results.expected: 400 for invalid status/priority filter values
results.actual: 400 "Invalid task status filter"; 400 "Invalid task status filter"; 400 "Invalid task priority filter"
results.details: Invalid filter enums rejected.

results.requirement: Unknown task list query parameters are rejected by service validation
results.expected: 400 based on TasksService.validateFilters() rejectUnknownFields(filters, ...)

results.requirement: Responses do not expose internal database/implementation fields
results.expected: No organizationId, nextTaskNumber, _id, __v or password fields in any task response
results.actual: No internal fields found in create/get/patch/list responses
results.details: organizationId is stripped by toTaskResponse(); nextTaskNumber is never part of a task.

results.requirement: Updating a task to its current status is allowed and is a no-op
results.expected: 200; status unchanged; updatedAt unchanged
results.details: No-op PATCH did not bump updatedAt.

results.requirement: Invalid status value is a validation error, not a transition error
results.expected: 400 Bad Request "Invalid task status"
results.details: Enum validation runs before state-machine check.

results.requirement: A new project issues task number 1 with key <projectKey>-1
results.expected: 201 with number=1 and key=projectKey-1
results.details: nextTaskNumber starts at 1 in InMemoryProjectsRepository.create().

results.requirement: Multiple sequential tasks in one project get distinct, increasing numbers
results.expected: 201 for each; numbers 2,3,4 with matching keys
results.details: Sequential numbering is per project and monotonic.

results.requirement: Task numbering is scoped per project
results.expected: A second project starts at number 1 independently of the first
results.details: Per-project counter confirmed.

results.requirement: Task numbering is scoped per organization/project, not globally
results.expected: A project in Org C starts its own sequence at 1
results.details: No global counter; counter lives on each project.

results.requirement: Deleting a task does not reuse or reset its number
results.expected: Next created task receives the next number after the highest previously issued
results.actual: Deleted #6; next task #7 (no reuse, no reset)
results.details: nextTaskNumber is only incremented, never decremented.

results.requirement: Concurrent task creation does not produce duplicate numbers
results.expected: 201 for all 30 requests with 30 distinct task numbers in one project
results.details: No duplicate task numbers across 3 rounds of 10 parallel creates in one project.
